lead.headline: MISSILES RAIN ON KYIV
lead.sublabel: Hours after the Shenzhen peace summit, Russia fires some 100 missiles and 400 drones at Ukraine — Kyiv's bridges are damaged, power is cut and Poland scrambles jets

panels.headline: THREE POWERS PLEDGE PEACE
panels.sublabel: Trump, Xi and Putin vow nuclear-risk talks in Shenzhen — 'a nuclear war can never be won' — but no breakthrough on Ukraine

panels.headline: GTA VI SMASHES ALL RECORDS
panels.sublabel: An estimated $2.36 billion in launch-day sales — 24.6 million copies, the biggest entertainment launch in history

panels.headline: CYCLONE AKVAN COMES ASHORE
panels.sublabel: Landfall near Gopalpur, Odisha: 370,000 people evacuated and heavy rain, but no major damage — the third cyclone in a month

panels.headline: TANKER ABLAZE NEAR HORMUZ
panels.sublabel: A tanker catches fire after hitting a mine as Iran widens its attacks — the IEA calls it history's greatest energy security threat

panels.headline: TAIWAN STOCKS PLUNGE
panels.sublabel: Taipei's index dives more than 2,300 points intraday and gold slips below $3,600 an ounce as risk appetite fades
